name: Lantern Archon

actions.name: Radiant Bolt
actions.effect: Undead and fiends take an additional 1d6 radiant.

actions.name: Guiding Light
actions.effect: One ally within 9m gains +1d6 to their next attack roll or save.

reactions.name: Shield of Light
reactions.effect: When an ally within 6m is targeted by an attack, the Lantern Archon interposes itself, granting the ally +3 to defenses against that attack.

traits.name: Aura of Light
traits.desc: Sheds bright light in a 6m radius. Undead and fiends in this light have -1d6 to attack rolls.

traits.name: Incorporeal
traits.desc: Can move through objects and creatures. Immune to being grappled or restrained.

lore: Lantern Archons are the smallest and most numerous of celestials, appearing as floating orbs of golden light. They serve as guides, messengers, and protectors of the innocent. Though individually fragile, their radiant presence weakens creatures of darkness.
